itinerary.title:
Day 1 -
Graceful Hanoi Arrival & Welcome Dinner
description:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai
International Airport, you are welcomed by a dedicated concierge
representative and escorted by luxury private transfer to Peridot Grand
Luxury Boutique Hotel. The day remains intentionally light, allowing you
and your group time to settle in and refresh. In the evening, a curated welcome
dinner introduces Northern Vietnamese cuisine in a refined setting, setting a
graceful tone for the journey ahead.
meals: Lunch is included for morning arrival; Dinner

itinerary.title:
Day 2 - Heritage
Hanoi: Mausoleum, Pagoda & Temple
description:
This half-day introduction to
Hanoi focuses on the capital’s essential cultural landmarks at an unhurried
pace. With a private historian guide, you visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, and the elegant Temple of Literature,
Vietnam’s first national university. The experience offers a thoughtful
perspective on national memory, Confucian heritage, and the ceremonial rhythm
of old Hanoi.

itinerary.title:
Day 3 - Local
Hanoi by Jeep: Cuisine, Backstreets & Train Street
description:
Your Hanoi Jeep Tour begins with hotel pick-up in the Hanoi Old
Quarter, followed by a safety briefing with your guide and driver. The
journey introduces both the elegant and hidden sides of the capital, passing
the Hanoi Opera House, local backstreets, alleyways, markets, homes and
everyday neighbourhoods that reveal how Hanoians truly live, work and gather.

The route continues past major landmarks such as
the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Thanh Nien Road, West Lake, Truc
Bach Lake, Banana Island, and Tran Quoc Pagoda. You also
explore quieter local areas, bonsai streets, hidden lanes and the B52
aircraft site, before ending with authentic Hanoi dishes at selected local
restaurants and food stalls.

itinerary.title:
Day 4 - Scenic
Ha Long: Luxury Cruise & Limestone Seascape
description:
After breakfast, you travel by private transfer from Hanoi to Ha
Long Bay, where the pace begins to slow as the city gives way to coastal
scenery. Upon arrival at the marina, board the distinguished Celina of the
Sea Cruise and check into your Executive Balcony suite.

Lunch is served onboard as the cruise begins moving
through the UNESCO-listed seascape of limestone islands, quiet coves, and open
water. The afternoon may include selected cruise activities depending on the
confirmed route and weather. As evening falls over Ha Long Bay, you
enjoy dinner onboard and spend the night surrounded by one of Vietnam’s most
iconic natural landscapes.

itinerary.title:
Day 5 - Seamless
Hoi An: Coastal Flight & Bespoke Tailoring
description:
Begin the day with the calm atmosphere of Ha Long Bay,
where the cruise may include a light onboard activity, final scenic passage, or
relaxed time on deck. After disembarkation, you transfer for a domestic flight
to Da Nang, continuing the journey from northern seascapes to Central
Vietnam.

Upon arrival, your private chauffeur provides a
seamless transfer to Anantara Hoi An Resort. Later, you enjoy a premium
bespoke tailoring consultation in Hoi An, a hallmark experience of this
historic trading port. The session introduces selected fabrics, silhouettes,
and personal styling, creating a refined connection to the town’s artisan
tradition.

itinerary.title:
Day 6 - Immersive
Hoi An: Ancient Town, Lanterns & Riverfront
description:
Your afternoon begins with pick-up from your Hoi An hotel before
heading to Cam Thanh Coconut Village. Here, you enjoy a peaceful boat
trip through the coconut forest, try paddling a traditional bamboo basket boat,
and watch a lively basket-boat performance before continuing to Hoi An
Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

In Hoi An, you explore key cultural landmarks
including the Traditional Performing Arts House, Museum of Trade
Ceramics, Tan Ky Ancient House, Cantonese Assembly Hall, and
the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge. As evening falls, enjoy the
lantern-lit Hoi An Night Market, a local specialty dinner, then take a
gentle Hoai River boat ride and release flower lanterns for good luck.

itinerary.title:
Day 7 - Relaxed
Hoi An: Portraits & Memories
description:
The day begins with a specialized photography experience in Hoi
An Ancient Town, arranged during the best available light for portraits of
you and your friends. The session captures your group against lantern-lined
streets, heritage façades, quiet alleys, and the riverside scenery of the Thu
Bon River, creating a personal visual memory of the journey.

After the photography session, the day slows into
leisure at Anantara Hoi An Resort. You may enjoy the riverside setting,
pool, spa, or private time at your own pace. The afternoon can also allow for
tailored fittings, boutique browsing, or quiet independent exploration around Hoi
An Ancient Town.

itinerary.title: Day 8 — Da Nang
description: The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, while some of the members say goodbye to Vietnam, the other continue their journey. Enjoy the afternoon at your own leisure to experience the city at your personal pace. Whether you prefer quiet moments of tranquility or spontaneous exploration, this time is entirely yours to shape as you wish.

itinerary.title: Day 9 — Da Nang
description:
A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car
              system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village
              before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.

itinerary.title: Day 10 — Hue
description:
A full-day excursion to the former imperial capital of
                Hue. The privately guided itinerary encompasses the majestic Imperial Citadel and the opulent royal
                mausoleums, offering an in-depth perspective on Vietnam's regal history and architectural grandeur under
                the Nguyen Dynasty.

itinerary.title: Day 11 — Da Nang
description:
A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront
                villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness
                offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned surprise, an exclusive dining
                experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team.

itinerary.title: Day 12 — Ho Chi Minh City
description:
Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh
                City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this
                remarkable underground network, meeting exclusively with a war veteran. The day concludes with check-in
                at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.

itinerary.title: Day 13 — Mekong Delta
description:
An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta.
                Traveling aboard a private river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local
                artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach
                to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.

itinerary.title: Day 14 — Departure
description:
The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy
                the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide
                a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a
                flawlessly executed luxury journey.

letter_intro:
I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey: Tina’s Vietnam
                    Birthday Escape, created for 11 passengers
                 travelling from 27 Mar – 09 Apr 2027. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Halong Bay – Hoi An – Da Nang – Hue – Ho Chi Minh City.
letter_body_p2:
The programme has been considered around a gentler friendly rhythm: early
                check-in in Hanoi, private guiding and transfers, a luxury overnight cruise, and enough space
                between active days to pause. Dining, room arrangements and transitions have been planned with care,
                without adding unnecessary movement.
letter_outro:
Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation.
                Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices, and priorities.

Upon arrival, a private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to the Anantara Hoi An Resort. The afternoon includes a premium bespoke tailoring consultation, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port.

A full-day guided exploration of the beautifully preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. The private tour delves into the architectural marvels and rich trading history of the area. The evening concludes with a refined dining experience, showcasing the intricate flavors of Central Vietnamese cuisine.

The morning features a specialized photography tour, designed to capture professional portraits of the family against the iconic, lantern-lit backdrop of Hoi An. The afternoon is reserved for leisure, allowing guests to fully enjoy the premium amenities and tranquil environment of the Anantara Resort.

The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, coupled with a curated half-day city tour highlighting local cultural landmarks. Guests will then check into a spectacular 3-Bedroom Beach Front Pool Villa at the Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa, providing an unparalleled standard of privacy and comfort.

A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.

itinerary.summary: A full-day excursion to the former imperial capital of Hue. The privately guided itinerary encompasses the majestic Imperial Citadel and the opulent royal mausoleums, offering an in-depth perspective on Vietnam's regal history and architectural grandeur under the Nguyen Dynasty.

A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned birthday celebration—an exclusive dining experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team within the privacy of the villa.

Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this remarkable underground network. The day concludes with check-in at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.

An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta. Traveling aboard a private luxury river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.

The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a flawlessly executed luxury journey.

edited_fields.day_title_1:
Day 1 -
Graceful Hanoi Arrival & Welcome Dinner
edited_fields.day_desc_1_0:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai
International Airport, you are welcomed by a dedicated concierge
representative and escorted by luxury private transfer to Peridot Grand
Luxury Boutique Hotel. The day remains intentionally light, allowing you
and your group time to settle in and refresh. In the evening, a curated welcome
dinner introduces Northern Vietnamese cuisine in a refined setting, setting a
graceful tone for the journey ahead.
edited_fields.day_highlights_1:
Fast-track Arrival Service,
Private airport pickup, Welcome Dinner
edited_fields.day_meals_1: Lunch is included for morning arrival; Dinner
edited_fields.day_title_2:
Day 2 - Heritage
Hanoi: Mausoleum, Pagoda & Temple
edited_fields.day_desc_2_0:
This half-day introduction to
Hanoi focuses on the capital’s essential cultural landmarks at an unhurried
pace. With a private historian guide, you visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, and the elegant Temple of Literature,
Vietnam’s first national university. The experience offers a thoughtful
perspective on national memory, Confucian heritage, and the ceremonial rhythm
of old Hanoi.
edited_fields.day_highlights_2:
Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex,
One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature

edited_fields.day_title_3:
Day 3 - Local
Hanoi by Jeep: Cuisine, Backstreets & Train Street
edited_fields.day_desc_3_0:
Your Hanoi Jeep Tour begins with hotel pick-up in the Hanoi Old
Quarter, followed by a safety briefing with your guide and driver. The
journey introduces both the elegant and hidden sides of the capital, passing
the Hanoi Opera House, local backstreets, alleyways, markets, homes and
everyday neighbourhoods that reveal how Hanoians truly live, work and gather.

The route continues past major landmarks such as
the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Thanh Nien Road, West Lake, Truc
Bach Lake, Banana Island, and Tran Quoc Pagoda. You also
explore quieter local areas, bonsai streets, hidden lanes and the B52
aircraft site, before ending with authentic Hanoi dishes at selected local
restaurants and food stalls.
edited_fields.day_highlights_3:
Local food, St. Joseph’s
Cathedral, French Quarter, Hanoi Opera House, Long Bien Bridge, West Lake,
Train Street
edited_fields.day_title_4:
Day 4 - Scenic
Ha Long: Luxury Cruise & Limestone Seascape
edited_fields.day_desc_4_0:
After breakfast, you travel by private transfer from Hanoi to Ha
Long Bay, where the pace begins to slow as the city gives way to coastal
scenery. Upon arrival at the marina, board the distinguished Celina of the
Sea Cruise and check into your Executive Balcony suite.

Lunch is served onboard as the cruise begins moving
through the UNESCO-listed seascape of limestone islands, quiet coves, and open
water. The afternoon may include selected cruise activities depending on the
confirmed route and weather. As evening falls over Ha Long Bay, you
enjoy dinner onboard and spend the night surrounded by one of Vietnam’s most
iconic natural landscapes.
edited_fields.day_highlights_4:
Ha Long Bay, Luxury cruise,
Birthday arrangement.
edited_fields.day_title_5:
Day 5 - Seamless
Hoi An: Coastal Flight & Bespoke Tailoring
edited_fields.day_desc_5_0:
Begin the day with the calm atmosphere of Ha Long Bay,
where the cruise may include a light onboard activity, final scenic passage, or
relaxed time on deck. After disembarkation, you transfer for a domestic flight
to Da Nang, continuing the journey from northern seascapes to Central
Vietnam.

Upon arrival, your private chauffeur provides a
seamless transfer to Anantara Hoi An Resort. Later, you enjoy a premium
bespoke tailoring consultation in Hoi An, a hallmark experience of this
historic trading port. The session introduces selected fabrics, silhouettes,
and personal styling, creating a refined connection to the town’s artisan
tradition.

edited_fields.day_title_6:
Day 6 - Immersive
Hoi An: Ancient Town, Lanterns & Riverfront
edited_fields.day_desc_6_0:
Your afternoon begins with pick-up from your Hoi An hotel before
heading to Cam Thanh Coconut Village. Here, you enjoy a peaceful boat
trip through the coconut forest, try paddling a traditional bamboo basket boat,
and watch a lively basket-boat performance before continuing to Hoi An
Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

In Hoi An, you explore key cultural landmarks
including the Traditional Performing Arts House, Museum of Trade
Ceramics, Tan Ky Ancient House, Cantonese Assembly Hall, and
the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge. As evening falls, enjoy the
lantern-lit Hoi An Night Market, a local specialty dinner, then take a
gentle Hoai River boat ride and release flower lanterns for good luck.
edited_fields.day_highlights_6:
Cam Thank Coconut Village, Hoi
An Ancient Town, Hoi An Night Market, Hoai River
edited_fields.day_title_7:
Day 7 - Relaxed
Hoi An: Portraits & Memories
edited_fields.day_desc_7_0:
The day begins with a specialized photography experience in Hoi
An Ancient Town, arranged during the best available light for portraits of
you and your friends. The session captures your group against lantern-lined
streets, heritage façades, quiet alleys, and the riverside scenery of the Thu
Bon River, creating a personal visual memory of the journey.

After the photography session, the day slows into
leisure at Anantara Hoi An Resort. You may enjoy the riverside setting,
pool, spa, or private time at your own pace. The afternoon can also allow for
tailored fittings, boutique browsing, or quiet independent exploration around Hoi
An Ancient Town.
edited_fields.day_highlights_7:
Hoi An Ancient Town,
Photography experience, Free afternoon

Enjoy the afternoon at your own leisure to experience the city at your personal pace. Whether you prefer quiet moments of tranquility or spontaneous exploration, this time is entirely yours to shape as you wish.
